items.role: Head of Data Engineering and Analytics
items.summary: Built the data and analytics team from scratch for a digital marketing company serving e-commerce clients. Owned strategy, hiring, vendors and delivery.
highlights: Combined Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, Amazon, Shopify, CJ, Impact Radius and other networks into one data lake
Connected online ad and e-commerce data with offline sales to measure the full funnel
Built multi-touch attribution models that cut wasted ad spend and lowered acquisition cost
Executive dashboards in Amazon QuickSight for marketing performance, conversion and revenue

items.summary: Founded and built alone an AI-first stock analytics SaaS covering 12,000+ US stocks and ETFs.
highlights: Natural-language screening engine that shows the filters it applied
Automated prompt pipeline that tests new prompts against live data and publishes only the ones that pass
Prototyped AI analyst agents for 28 investing styles, each with its own screens and risk checks

items.role: VP of Data Engineering, direct-to-consumer digital brands
items.summary: Built and led data engineering and analytics for a consumer business selling online in the US, UK, Mexico and Spain, across FreedomPop, Unreal Mobile and later Boost Mobile / Boost Infinite.
highlights: Full-funnel KPIs: acquisition, activation, billing, retention, churn, lifetime value and revenue per user
Combined 20+ sources, including SAP, CRM, payments, marketing networks and Firebase, into one data lake
Supply chain and revenue-checking reports for Finance and Operations
Set data quality, governance and reporting standards on Redshift, BigQuery, Pentaho and Airflow

items.summary: Led data and analytics work on marketing, customer acquisition and financial results for a large digital media network; designed data marts, ETL and executive reporting.
Built the data warehouse and BI stack (MySQL, Vertica, Pentaho) for a fast-growing online retailer with several subscription brands.
highlights: OLAP cubes and executive dashboards for sales, cohorts, customer behavior and fraud
Processed terabytes of clickstream and sales data for conversion and merchandising analysis

items.summary: Built the company's first data warehouse for an online lead marketplace, with data marts for pricing, quality and performance. Hired, mentored and led the team.
First engineer. Designed the original architecture for the coupons and deals site and helped it grow to a $100M acquisition by Cox Target Media.
